assumptions: Collision geometry and robot-specific joint/actuator limits are validated before training.
The initial posture belongs to a separately tested terrain/posture operating envelope.

confidence_rationale: Large controlled simulation ablations, a 20-trial main real-robot comparison, robustness probes and public implementation support the mechanism. Confidence is capped by small hardware denominators, proprioception-only collision risk and unresolved multi-posture interference.

evidence.note: Defines multi-critic standing-up control, randomization, ablations, real trials and sim-to-real limits.

evidence.locator: HostGround.step, update_force_curriculum, ActorCritic.critics and RolloutStorage.multi_critic_advantages at 70bb580
evidence.note: Maps pulling/action curricula and multiple-critic optimization to official code.

question: 不依赖示范轨迹时，如何让人形机器人从多种接触姿态平稳起身？

safety_case.command_limits: Derive robot- and firmware-specific position, velocity, torque, current, temperature, contact-force and action-rescale limits; paper values are not deployment limits.
safety_case.emergency_stop: Test an independent human-accessible emergency stop and safe power-removal behavior before any unsupported motion.
safety_case.protective_controls: Use compatible fall arrest or padded capture, a cleared exclusion zone, pinch/contact protection, current/thermal monitoring and a dedicated safety operator.
safety_case.robot_specific_warning: The main hardware evidence is a 23-DoF Unitree G1; H1/H1-2 and other morphologies expose different torque and upper-body contact gaps and require new validation.
safety_case.staged_deployment: Proceed from fixed-seed simulation and collision audit to supported low-speed single-posture tests, then bounded surfaces/postures, and only after acceptance to unsupported recovery.

statement: 在 HoST 报告的 23-DoF G1 设置中，分阶段奖励的多 critic PPO、逐步撤除的竖直拉力、动作幅度 curriculum 与平滑正则共同实现了四类场景起身；实机主试验为 20/20，但纯本体感觉仍可能碰撞环境，结果不能作为未知姿态或其他机器人的安全保证。
